2026-12-06.title: Second Sunday of Annunciation
2026-12-06.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Balaam receives instructions from the angel
Pray that we may declare the mystery of Christ
The Annunciation of the birth of Christ
2026-12-06.verse: Then Mary said, “Here am I, the servant of the Lord; let it be with me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

2026-12-13.title: Third Sunday of Annunciation
2026-12-13.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: God confirms the promise to Abraham
Paul is called to make known the mystery of Christ
The birth of John the Baptist
2026-12-13.verse: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And all of them were amazed. Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue freed, and he began to speak, praising God.

2026-12-20.title: Fourth Sunday of Annunciation
2026-12-20.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Isaac receives Rebekah according to the will of God
Discern the will of the Lord
God's intervention in the birth of Jesus: the annunciation to Joseph
2026-12-20.verse: When Joseph awoke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him; he took her as his wife.

2026-12-25.title: Christmas – The Nativity of Our Lord (Yalda)
2026-12-25.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: The virgin shall bear a son; a child is born for us
The King who is to come from Bethlehem
God sent his Son, born of a woman
2026-12-25.verse: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid; for see—I am bringing you good news of great joy for all the people: to you is born this day in the city of David a Savior, who is the Messiah, the Lord.”

2026-12-27.title: First Sunday of Nativity · Feast of the Holy Family
2026-12-27.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: He created them male and female
The Holy Family flees to Egypt
2026-12-27.verse: Then Joseph got up, took the child and his mother by night, and went to Egypt.

2026-12-01.title: First Tuesday of Annunciation
2026-12-01.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Now is the moment to wake from sleep
Zechariah did not believe the angel
2026-12-01.verse: Because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their time, you will become mute, unable to speak, until the day these things occur.

2026-12-02.title: First Wednesday of Annunciation
2026-12-02.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Jesus is sent by the Father
2026-12-02.verse: And the one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what is pleasing to him.

2026-12-03.title: First Thursday of Annunciation · St Francis Xavier
2026-12-03.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: There is no other God besides me
2026-12-03.verse: And he said to them, “Go into all the world and proclaim the good news to the whole creation.”

2026-12-04.title: First Friday of Annunciation · First Friday
2026-12-04.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Seek the things that are above
2026-12-04.verse: But blessed are your eyes, for they see, and your ears, for they hear. Truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, but did not see it.

2026-12-05.title: First Saturday of Annunciation
2026-12-05.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
2026-12-05.verse: Jesus said to him, “No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.”

2026-12-07.title: Second Monday of Annunciation · St Ambrose
2026-12-07.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Nothing is impossible for those who believe
2026-12-07.verse: If in my name you ask me for anything, I will do it.

2026-12-08.title: Second Tuesday of Annunciation · Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
2026-12-08.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: The virgin will bear a son
God has spoken to us by a Son
2026-12-08.verse: For the Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is his name. His mercy is for those who fear him from generation to generation.

2026-12-09.title: Second Wednesday of Annunciation
2026-12-09.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Behold the handmaid of the Lord
2026-12-09.verse: For nothing will be impossible with God.

2026-12-10.title: Second Thursday of Annunciation
2026-12-10.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Love one another with mutual affection
2026-12-10.verse: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.

2026-12-11.title: Second Friday of Annunciation
2026-12-11.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
2026-12-11.verse: He has brought down the powerful from their thrones, and lifted up the lowly; he has filled the hungry with good things.

2026-12-12.title: Second Saturday of Annunciation
2026-12-12.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Do not turn away from the living God
Your eye is the lamp of your body
2026-12-12.verse: Your eye is the lamp of your body. If your eye is healthy, your whole body is full of light.

2026-12-14.title: Third Monday of Annunciation · St John of the Cross
2026-12-14.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: A good tree bears good fruit
2026-12-14.verse: The good person out of the good treasure of the heart produces good… for it is out of the abundance of the heart that the mouth speaks.

2026-12-15.title: Third Tuesday of Annunciation
2026-12-15.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Salvation is the gift of God
The kingdom of heaven has come near
2026-12-15.verse: This is the one of whom the prophet Isaiah spoke when he said, “The voice of one crying out in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.’”

2026-12-16.title: Third Wednesday of Annunciation
2026-12-16.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Fidelity to the word of God
2026-12-16.verse: Whoever is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much; and whoever is dishonest in a very little is dishonest also in much.

2026-12-17.title: Third Thursday of Annunciation
2026-12-17.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Those who have put on Christ
2026-12-17.verse: By the tender mercy of our God, the dawn from on high will break upon us, to give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

2026-12-18.title: Third Friday of Annunciation · The Miraculous Cross at Mylapore
2026-12-18.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: God raised Jesus whom you crucified
Jesus the Way, the Truth and the Life
2026-12-18.verse: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.”

2026-12-19.title: Third Saturday of Annunciation
2026-12-19.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Chosen by the grace of God
The one who comes from above is above all
2026-12-19.verse: He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for he gives the Spirit without measure.

2026-12-21.title: Fourth Monday of Annunciation
2026-12-21.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: In the beginning was the Word
2026-12-21.verse: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

2026-12-22.title: Fourth Tuesday of Annunciation
2026-12-22.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: The Son of God born of a woman
The one who came to witness to the Light
2026-12-22.verse: But when the fullness of time had come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law, in order to redeem those who were under the law, so that we might receive adoption as children.

2026-12-23.title: Fourth Wednesday of Annunciation
2026-12-23.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
2026-12-23.verse: For a child has been born for us, a son given to us; authority rests upon his shoulders; and he is named Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

2026-12-24.title: Fourth Thursday of Annunciation · Christmas Eve
2026-12-24.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
2026-12-24.verse: But you, O Bethlehem of Ephrathah, who are one of the little clans of Judah, from you shall come forth for me one who is to rule in Israel, whose origin is from of old, from ancient days.

2026-12-26.title: First Saturday of Nativity · St Stephen, Protomartyr
2026-12-26.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Whoever endures to the end will be saved
2026-12-26.verse: While they were stoning Stephen, he prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.” Then he knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.”

2026-12-28.title: First Monday of Nativity · Holy Childhood Day (The Holy Innocents)
2026-12-28.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: A voice of lamentation in Ramah
2026-12-28.verse: A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing and loud lamentation, Rachel weeping for her children; she refused to be consoled, because they are no more.

2026-12-29.title: First Tuesday of Nativity
2026-12-29.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: The boy Jesus in the Temple
2026-12-29.verse: He said to them, “Why were you searching for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?”

2026-12-30.title: First Wednesday of Nativity
2026-12-30.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: My grace is sufficient for you
2026-12-30.verse: But he said to them, “It is I; do not be afraid.”

2026-12-31.title: First Thursday of Nativity · End of the Year
2026-12-31.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Fight the good fight of the faith
Let us bear fruit: the fig tree given another year
2026-12-31.verse: He replied, ‘Sir, let it alone for one more year, until I dig around it and put manure on it. If it bears fruit next year, well and good; but if not, you can cut it down.’
